amendments.normalized_body: `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1050-1056` accidentally puts `temp_condition_low_divisor_c` and `temp_condition_high_divisor_c` into the `<= 1.0` validation bucket, and `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1136-1139` rejects any value above 1.0. These are temperature-span parameters, not unit-interval weights; the shipped preset already sets `10.0` and `8.0` in `crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml:36-37`. Because shrimp preset loading always runs `ShrimpPreset::validate` (`crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:98-105`, `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:225-229`), the default `neocaridina_davidi` preset is rejected and scenario materialization can fail immediately.
